mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID: CodeMapper.selectCodeCount */ COUNT(*) FROM dtmeta.tb_portal_code cd1 WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: CodeMapper.selectCodeList */ cd1.mtcd_grp_id , cd1.mtcd , cd1.mtcd_nm , cd1.mtcd_use_yn , cd1.mtcd_sort_odrg , cd1.mtcd_desc , cd1.up_mtcd , cd1.mtcd_regr_id , cd1.mtcd_regr_nm , to_char(cd1.mtcd_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS mtcd_reg_dt , cd1.mtcd_amdr_id , cd1.mtcd_amdr_nm , to_char(cd1.mtcd_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS mtcd_amd_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_portal_code cd1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code cd2 on cd1.up_mtcd = cd2.mtcd WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: CodeMapper.selectCode */ mtcd_grp_id , mtcd , mtcd_nm , mtcd_use_yn , mtcd_sort_odrg , mtcd_desc , up_mtcd , mtcd_regr_id , mtcd_regr_nm , to_char(cd1.mtcd_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS mtcd_reg_dt , mtcd_amdr_id , mtcd_amdr_nm , to_char(cd1.mtcd_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS mtcd_amd_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_portal_code cd1 WHERE mtcd_grp_id = #{mtcdGrpId} AND mtcd = #{mtcd}
